description: Sharing & Export - Implement shareable read-only trip links, PDF export with map snapshot, calendar (.ics) export, and WhatsApp/native share functionality.
steps: 1. Run migrations/004_trip_sharing.sql in Supabase SQL Editor. This adds share_id (TEXT UNIQUE) and is_public (BOOLEAN DEFAULT false) columns to saved_trips table, creates index on share_id, and adds RLS policy for public read access when is_public=true.

2. Create src/services/shareService.ts with functions: generateShareLink(tripId) that generates nanoid(10), updates database with share_id and is_public=true, returns share URL; revokeShareLink(tripId) that sets is_public=false.

3. Create src/pages/SharedTrip.tsx component that fetches trip by share_id using public RLS policy (no auth required), renders read-only itinerary with TravelMap, BudgetBreakdown, and ActivitiesItinerary. Add 'Create your own trip' CTA button. Show watermark 'Shared trip' in header.
4. Update src/App.tsx routing to handle /trip/:shareId route and render SharedTrip component.

5. Create src/services/pdfExport.ts using @react-pdf/renderer. Implement exportTripToPDF(itinerary, mapSnapshot) that creates PDF document with trip name, day-by-day stops with times, budget breakdown, and map image. Use html2canvas to capture map element as data URL for embedding.

6. Create src/services/calendarExport.ts using ical-generator. Implement exportToCalendar(itinerary) that creates .ics file with one event per stop. Parse timeOfDay field to set event start times, use stop.durationHours for end time, include lat/lng in location field.

7. Extend src/services/shareService.ts with shareTrip(itinerary, shareUrl) function. Use navigator.share() if available (mobile native share), otherwise fallback to WhatsApp Web URL with pre-filled text.

8. Add Share button to src/components/TripPlanner.tsx action bar. On click, open modal showing: 'Generate Link' button (calls generateShareLink, copies to clipboard with toast), 'Export PDF' button, 'Add to Calendar' button, 'Share via WhatsApp' button, and 'Revoke Link' button.
9. Create src/components/ShareModal.tsx to display sharing options with loading states. Show spinner while generating PDF (can take 2-3s). Display success/error toasts for each action.
10. Add unit tests for share link generation, calendar export event creation, and share URL formatting in src/services/shareService.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Share button generates unique link with format /trip/{nanoid}, copies to clipboard
Visiting /trip/:shareId loads read-only trip view using public RLS policy (works without login)
Export PDF downloads file with itinerary, map snapshot, and budget breakdown
Add to Calendar downloads .ics file compatible with Google Calendar/Outlook/Apple Calendar
Share button uses native share on mobile, WhatsApp fallback on desktop
Revoke button makes share link inaccessible (returns 404 or 'Trip not available')
All sharing features require authentication (gate with requireAuth from FEAT-001)
Unit tests pass for share service (npm run test)
verification: npm run lint - TypeScript strict mode passes
npm run test - all tests pass including new share service tests
Manual: Save a trip, click Share, verify link is copied and /trip/:shareId loads in new incognito tab
Manual: Click Export PDF, verify download starts and PDF contains itinerary + map
Manual: Click Add to Calendar, verify .ics downloads and imports correctly to Google Calendar
Manual: Click Share on mobile device, verify native share sheet appears
Manual: Click Revoke on shared trip, verify share link becomes inaccessible
